purpose: Test only whether the result-independent rolling-history repair makes the NSESche faithful-native anchor exactly reproduce the frozen FaaSRank decision path on untouched same-seed tapes. No NSESche performance candidate is generated, executed, summarized or selected in V74.

source.V73_fidelity_finding: The faithful anchor failed exact fidelity on all ten E420-E429 seeds. Candidate summaries were not opened and candidate interpretation was prohibited.

result_independent_diagnosis.baseline_contract: FaaSRank records each placement immediately and truncates decision_history to its most recent 256 entries before scoring the next placement in the same scheduling window.
result_independent_diagnosis.V73_anchor_mismatch: The old faithful initializer scored all current-window placements on top of the prior 256-entry history and truncated only after the full batch, so stale prior decisions remained in diversity scoring too long.
result_independent_diagnosis.interpretation: The ordering of the three events is consistent with a scheduler-path mismatch followed later by a common-HPA trajectory divergence; it was established without consulting either V73 candidate summary.

repair_scope.change: For the faithful-native profiles only, update the local rolling FaaSRank history after every placement and evict the oldest entry immediately when the 256-entry cap is exceeded.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit and push this plan before generating any E430-E439 run spec, tape or output.
Generate exactly two ten-run manifests from one fresh source: frozen FaaSRank and repaired faithful anchor.
Capture ten base tapes once, derive ten scale5 tapes and bind identical per-seed hashes to both manifests.
Bind the frozen FaaSRank model to the comparator and verify the anchor uses the same frozen weights; build exactly ten anchor references before online execution.
Run FaaSRank first and the faithful anchor second, strictly serially without reading intermediate performance.
Require twenty attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact two-way pairing and one runtime identity before opening only the comparator and anchor summaries exactly once.

analysis.primary_gate: For every seed, the repaired faithful anchor and FaaSRank must have exactly equal completed-request count and bitwise-equal finite scientific summary values for fixed-window throughput, mean latency, cost, finite-only QPR state and zero-as-zero QPR.
analysis.missing_or_nonfinite_rule: Both sides must have the same explicitly represented finite/nonfinite state for every gated field; any asymmetric missing or nonfinite state fails.
analysis.pass_threshold: Ten of ten seeds must pass every exact field comparison. Nine of ten fails.
analysis.uncertainty_or_aggregate_override: No aggregate mean, confidence interval or apparent improvement can override a single fidelity mismatch.
analysis.success_action: Freeze the complete V74 cohort and preregister a separate performance-candidate screen beginning at E440. Do not reuse E430-E439 for candidate selection or confirmation.
analysis.failure_action: Freeze the complete V74 cohort, stop this faithful-native mechanism path and perform result-independent mechanism diagnosis only. Do not inspect or reinterpret the unopened V73 candidate summaries.
